description: Custom fields (metafields) on the merchant's Shopify store. action list (metafieldOwnerId: a product, variant, collection, order, draft order, page, article or blog id, or "shop"; namespace), set (metafields [{ownerId, namespace, key, type, value}] up to 25, or one with ownerId, namespace, key, type, value; type e.g. single_line_text_field, multi_line_text_field, number_integer, number_decimal, boolean, json, url, date; an existing field keeps its type), delete (confirm:true), definitions (ownerType PRODUCT, ORDER, COLLECTION, …), create_definition (name, namespace, key, type, ownerType, description). Customer, location and market metafields are not available: Hermoso does not ask for those permissions. Read back from Shopify. Free.

confirm.description: delete: true after the user agreed

metafieldOwnerId.description: what the metafields belong to: gid://shopify/Product/123 and the like, or "shop"

ownerType.description: definitions: PRODUCT, PRODUCTVARIANT, COLLECTION, ORDER, DRAFTORDER, PAGE, ARTICLE, BLOG, SHOP, …

value.description: a JSON value is stored as text

name: manage_shopify_metafields
title: Shopify metafields
